methodology.test: Mann-Whitney U (two-sided, tie-corrected, normal approximation with continuity correction)
methodology.rationale: Impression counts are heavily right-skewed; rank-based tests are robust to that shape. Cliff's delta floor of 0.20 excludes tiny-but-significant differences that aren't practically actionable.

Bregman with a two-out, two-run shot in the ninth to tie it.

Then PCA singled in the 11th, broke for third, and scored when the Blue Jays throw sailed into left.

That's 11 walk-off wins this season. Good teams find a way.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

Still holding the line.

Cubs sit atop the NL Wild Card race with a five-game cushion — and the calendar is shrinking fast.

Brewers still lead the division. That chase still lives. Chicago baseball is going to matter in October.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

The Cardinals spent the summer sweeping the Cubs at Wrigley.

Thirteen-and-a-half games back in the division, on their way to face the Reds tonight.

They won that series. The Cubs still own October. Keep the receipts.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

PCA just joined a two-person club.

Back-to-back 30-30 seasons. Sammy Sosa (1993, 1995) is the only other Cub who's done it — and even Sosa never went back-to-back.

In one night: leadoff blast, walk-off blast, franchise history.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

Pete Crow-Armstrong's WAR sits at 7.5 — No. 1 in ALL of baseball.

The jump from +700 at the All-Star break to -120 on DraftKings isn't a hot streak. It's a recalibration. The voters are catching up to what Chicago fans already knew.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB
